Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The verification code incorrectly determined PS availability by checking whether the substring "ps" appeared in each article’s entry_id, which is just the identifier URL and not an indicator of available file formats. It also relied on a likely invalid date filter field. This flawed method guaranteed a count of zero and wrongly confirmed the initial result instead of examining the article links/format metadata to detect actual PS versions.
